title: Auth fail-closed on store error is a load-bearing security property
description: auth.rs classify() returns AuthError::WhoIsFailed (maps to 500) when the contact store returns an error, rather than Unauthorized (401). This is correct: a store failure should not silently deny access (confusing for debugging) nor accidentally grant access. A future contributor might change the error to Unauthorized to 'simplify' error handling — defend it: the 500 distinction signals infrastructure failure vs. auth denial, which matters for alerting and debugging.
